using JSON3, Base64
d = mktempdir()
write(joinpath(d, "fwbench.py"), base64decode(""))

t0 = time()
o = try read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -lc $cmd`); stderr = stdout), String) catch e "ERR " * sprint(showerror, e) end

res["data"] = isfile(joinpath(d, "out.json")) ? JSON3.read(read(joinpath(d, "out.json"), String), Dict{String,Any}) : nothing
println(JSON3.write(res))
